description: How Agent Booster improves itself. The loop is deterministic: no model, no secret. It proposes; a person merges.
level_meaning: L0 evals exist; L1 evals gate merges in CI; L2 a scheduled loop runs and writes proposals; L3 the loop improves itself. Agent Booster is at L2: .github/workflows/improve.yml runs scripts/improve.mjs daily and writes a proposal. It is not L3: the loop does not change its own steps.

loop.note: review runs the golden evals; extract compares them with eval/baseline.json; propose lists failing cases and outdated or deprecated dependencies and tries the in-range updates on the CI runner; validate is CI on the pull request; ship is a person merging it.

eval.rubric: eval/golden.test.ts (15 binary golden cases, including CLI and MCP agreement) and src/__tests__/ (7 end-to-end cases), run by pnpm test and pnpm eval
eval.gate: all tests and evals pass && evals_passed >= eval/baseline.json

externalIntelligence.source: none yet; the loop reads only this repository and the package registry
